title: Night Creatures
content: Here's a gouache painting I did over 30 years ago when I was putting together a portfolio of science fiction samples. It has never been published before.I imagine encountering these night creatures in a dark bar. I accidentally offend them by asking an innocent question about their feeding tentacles. I apologize, and they return to their drinks, the veins on their temples throbbing for a while.That's my little treat for you on Halloween!
